title: Add bounded pending publish retry classification
summary: Adds a bounded pending-publish retry ceiling and exposes retry-exhausted parked rows as dead-letter review evidence.
reason: The autonomy pilot needs pending-publish retries to stop accumulating invisible repeat attempts. Existing manifests already persist retry_count on retry-state failures; this slice makes retry_count >= 3 block further drain attempts and surfaces that state in backend diagnostics/preview evidence.
behavior_before: A pending-publish manifest could continue through the drain trust path even when retry_count had reached the autonomy retry budget, and the pending preview did not expose retry budget/dead-letter review fields.
behavior_after: Test-PendingManifestTrustedForDrain refuses retry_count >= 3 as retry_exhausted before drain transaction work runs, durable drain summaries include retry_count/retry_limit evidence, pending preview rows expose retry_count/retry_limit/retry_exhausted/dead_letter_status, and /api/pending-publish includes desktop_pending_publish_retry_budget.v1. Exhausted rows remain parked for operator review.
manual_validation: PowerShell Parser.ParseFile pending_manifest_store.ps1 and pending_push.ps1 - passed
Python import check with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 - passed
git diff --check -- touched files - passed (line-ending warnings only)
rollback_plan: Remove the retry ceiling helpers/check from pending_manifest_store.ps1, remove retry_count/retry_limit from pending drain summary items, revert retry/dead-letter fields from pending manifest rows and pending preview DTOs, and rerun the pending-publish Python/PowerShell safety suites. Rollback does not touch parked payloads, manifests, source media, or final output files.
notes:
High-risk pending-publish evidence classification only. This packet does not intentionally change pending-publish drain, final publish, source/scratch/output movement, cleanup, FFmpeg/subtitle/audio policy, settings persistence, queue mutation, or WebView command ownership.
Added pending_policy.py coverage after strict worktree coverage reported the pending-publish policy file as uncovered.
Added generated pending-publish summaries after final summary refresh.
Second autonomy hardening slice: explicit pending-publish retry ceiling and retry-exhausted/dead-letter review classification. Exhausted rows remain parked; this does not delete, move, repair, publish, or drain payloads.
